Falconer | Founding Backend Engineer | HYBRID (USA, SF Bay Area preferred) | Full-time | $150-250K + equity | https://falconer.com

Hey HN! I’m an engineer at Falconer, a well-funded SF startup building the future of self-updating knowledge.

We’re a small team where everyone excels at what they do. At Falconer, you’ll join former staff-level engineers from Meta, Uber, Google, and Amazon, alongside others deeply involved in open-source culture, including myself.

As a founding engineer, you'll have a major impact on our product development and technical direction over our infrastructure.

To apply: https://falconer.com/jobs?ashby_jid=cf424d45-bc08-4036-be3d-...
